Introduction

Kindness, turned into everyday help

Uttam Dhara Foundation works from Near Sona Public School, Chounpatti, Delhi - 90. We bring neighbours, volunteers and donors together to support the people around us who need it most.

Our vision and mission

Vision

A neighbourhood where nobody goes without food, learning or care, and where every person is treated as family.

Meet the team

Mission

To turn every donation into direct help for people in need, and to be open about where each rupee goes.

Privacy policy

Last updated: October 25, 2026

Uttam Dhara Foundation (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website, how we use it and the choices you have.

1. Information we collect

  • Contact form: your name, email address and message. They reach us as an email sent from your own email app.
  • Newsletter: your email address, sent to us the same way when you subscribe.
  • Donations: you pay by UPI from your own payment app. This website does not collect or store your card, bank or UPI PIN details. We may see your name, UPI ID and the amount in our bank records.
  • Website data: this website sets no cookies of its own and has no advertising trackers. The page loads fonts from Google, which may receive your IP address and browser details.

2. How we use it

We use your information to reply to your messages, send updates you asked for, record and acknowledge donations, and meet legal and accounting duties.

3. Sharing

We do not sell your information. We share it only with services needed to run the foundation, such as email and banking, or when the law requires it.

4. Photos

Our gallery shows photos of people. If you appear in a photo and want it removed, email us and we will take it down.

5. Other websites

Links such as Google Maps directions and UPI apps open services we do not control. Their own privacy policies apply.

6. Your choices

You can ask us to show, correct or delete your information, or unsubscribe from updates, at any time by email. We keep information only as long as we need it.

7. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page.

8. Contact us

Terms of use

Last updated: October 25, 2026

Welcome to the Uttam Dhara Foundation website. By using it, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

1. Donations

Donations are voluntary and are paid by UPI to the UPI ID shown on this website. Please check the UPI ID before you pay. Donations are not refundable as a rule. If you paid by mistake, email us with your payment reference and we will review it. Ask us by email if you need an acknowledgement of your donation. Tax treatment depends on our registration and your own situation, so please check with us before you rely on it.

2. Our content

The text, logo and design of this website belong to Uttam Dhara Foundation. Photos in the gallery are credited where shown. Please do not copy or reuse our content without our written permission.

3. Acceptable use

Do not misuse the website, try to break or overload it, or use it to mislead other people.

4. Accuracy

We try to keep the information on this website correct and up to date, but we do not guarantee it. We may change or remove content at any time.

5. Other websites

This website links to services we do not control. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

6. Limit of liability

This website is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for any indirect loss that results from using it.

7. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts in Delhi have jurisdiction over any dispute.

8. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.

9. Contact us
